fields.title: Species
fields.label: We expect the longest-lived species to have the most resilient brains. A bowhead whale can live about two centuries and a naked mole-rat outlives other rodents of its size by decades, so we compare their brains with human brains to find protective molecules and cell states.

artwork.alt: Painting of a bowhead whale, a Greenland shark, a horse, an elephant, a bat and a mouse around a human.
